business_problem: State Grid Shandong needed to make AI practical across customer service, line safety and internal document work in an enormous utility environment where traditional business processes were slow and heavily manual.
solution_summary: State Grid Shandong used Baidu AI Cloud to build an AI middle platform that could serve both infrastructure operations and customer-facing energy services. In the service hall, the platform supports self-service kiosks and facial-recognition-based identity verification so users can handle common electricity tasks without waiting in line. In grid operations, the same AI foundation powers a transmission-channel visualization platform that recognizes construction vehicles, smoke, fire and foreign objects in complex outdoor scenes, turning camera feeds into safety alerts. In office operations, the utility also added intelligent writing capabilities that extract local热点 information, recommend writing materials and help polish content for internal communications. Technically, the platform combines Baidu's AI models with a packaged training and deployment environment so multiple power-utility scenarios can share the same governance and runtime base. That made AI useful across both the customer journey and the production side of the electric grid.

solution_components.name: PaddlePaddle All-in-One Appliance
solution_components.role: Provides packaged AI infrastructure for model delivery into power-utility scenarios.

solution_components.name: BML Full-Function AI Development Platform
solution_components.role: Supports training and management of utility AI models.

solution_components.name: AI Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the shared foundation for line inspection, customer service and internal writing workflows.

solution_components.name: Facial Recognition
solution_components.role: Enables identity-aware customer-service workflows in utility halls.

data_flow: Kiosk sessions, face-recognition checks, camera feeds and office-document requests all flow through the AI middle platform, which serves recognition outputs, safety alerts and writing assistance back into Shandong's customer and operations workflows.
business_outcome: Shandong moved AI from isolated demos into live utility scenarios, cutting wait times, improving line-inspection accuracy and adding automation to internal operations.
architecture_clues: One AI middle platform supports both customer-service halls and outdoor line inspection
Face recognition is tied into hall-service and queue-management flows
The same platform also serves intelligent writing assistance
evidence_quotes: Customers can use the intelligent service kiosk to complete 22 common electricity services, reducing average time by 70% (original: “智能业务办理一体机”……更名、过户等22项常见用电业务，用户平均花费时间节省70%).

The transmission-channel visualization platform improved construction-vehicle recognition from 80% to 95%, smoke from 70% to 90% and wire-foreign-object recognition from 60% to 80% (original: 各类施工车辆识别准确率由原来的80%提升到95%，烟火识别准确率由70%提升到了90%，导线异物识别准确率由60%提升到了80%).
The AI middle platform also provides intelligent writing support for internal documents and information releases (original: 百度“AI中台”提供了智能写作能力，建立人工智能辅助写作组件).
